Not written yet. Until it is, the demo Traveller is the worked example: every part of it carries a note saying what the field is for and what reads it.

The worked example

  • @UUID[Compendium.mgt2.demo-actors.Actor.demoCharTravellr]{Demo — Traveller}

Not written yet. The Item types the system registers are below, from the manifest.

Ammunition

Rounds, and what they override on the weapon they are loaded into. Empty means the weapon's own.

Armor

Career

Cargo lot

A lot in the hold: freight with a destination and a deadline, or a speculative purchase with neither.

Ship component

One row of a ship's design. Optional: a spacecraft stores its own ratings and is complete without any.

Computer

Contact

Container (backpack, chest)

Bounty contract

A bounty contract: the portion handed to the Travellers, and the referee's own.

Disease

Sub-types: Disease · Poison · Wound

Drug

A dose, what it does and what it leaves behind. The timing fields are empty where the book states none.

Equipment

Sub-types: Augment · Clothing · Equipment · Trinket · Toolkit

Item

Sub-types: Loot · Software

Passage

One booking rather than one passenger: a class, a head count and a fare, for a single jump.

Crew Station

Species

Skill & Psionic Talent

Sub-types: Skill · Psionic talent

Weapon
